whats_new:
- Added: switching a customer's release channel, or turning admin actions on/off, now shows a confirmation message when it succeeds, not just when it fails.
- Added: triggering a live update from the portal now asks for confirmation first.
- Added: onboarding now cleans up the temporary plaintext secrets bundle from the admin's own machine after setup completes, instead of leaving it behind.
- Fixed: a markdown table containing bold, italic, or code-formatted text with a "|" character in it (e.g. a status code) no longer desyncs the table's columns.
- Fixed: pressing Enter twice quickly in the login password field could submit the login twice.
- Fixed: dashboard KPI and chart errors now show the real server error message instead of a generic one, making outages easier to diagnose.
- Fixed: the feedback "thumbs up" button could be clicked repeatedly before the request completed, recording duplicate feedback.
- Fixed: several remaining network requests with no timeout could hang indefinitely on a dropped connection; all now fail visibly instead.
- Fixed: several portal admin actions could fail silently with an unhandled error instead of a visible message.
- Fixed: a folder/category-based report recipe (used across several report types) could match the wrong item, or miss matches entirely, when a folder name wasn't unique.
- Fixed: a fabricated table/column reference in one report example has been corrected to the real schema.
- Fixed: the dead-inventory report could count items that were still in an unposted/pending state.
- Fixed: EBMSLiveAgent and the Cloudflare Tunnel service now genuinely recover after an unexpected crash -- previously a restart could be attempted but silently fail to actually bring the service back.
- Fixed: an update triggered from the portal could occasionally hang indefinitely with no timeout; update and service start/stop operations are now all time-bounded.
- Fixed: the installer and updater's own internal locking could occasionally misbehave under specific timing; hardened against several such races.
- Fixed: log rotation could, in rare cases, stall the whole background service; decoupled from the process that could block it.
- Fixed: uninstalling now actually tracks and reports real cleanup failures instead of always reporting success, and properly runs Python's own uninstaller rather than just deleting files.
- Fixed: the installer's own downloads (Python, Cloudflare Tunnel) are now bounded, so a stalled download no longer hangs the install indefinitely.
- Fixed: a missing or empty configuration file during install/update now fails immediately with a clear message instead of a confusing later crash.
- Performance: scheduled auto-update times are now randomized per install, so many customers no longer hit the update server at the same moment.
- Security: `/feedback` and several other endpoints now cap field lengths and rate-limit requests, closing a few narrow abuse/resource-exhaustion gaps.
- Security: dashboard and chart endpoints, and portal-token-gated endpoints, now rate-limit independently instead of sharing a bucket with login -- heavy normal use of one no longer risks locking out the other.
- Security: closed a rare SQL-safety-filter gap where a comment or literal string could hide a disallowed table/schema reference from the write-keyword and schema-isolation checks.
- Security: a Postgres error message could occasionally leak more raw detail than intended in an error response; now sanitized.
- Security: login attempts are now capped to a fixed memory footprint, closing a pre-authentication unbounded-growth gap.
